name: overuse-warning
intent: Repeated ACTIVATE escalates OUTPUT STRAIN through five frozen steps; WARNING+ adds hazard corner plates and one-shot ink jitter; ACTIVATE disabled at EXHAUSTED.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip fill transition and ink jitter; jump directly to each level's final width and chrome

acceptance: Five deterministic strain steps at 580ms fill per ACTIVATE
WARNING (85%) and EXHAUSTED (100%) show hazard corner plates and hatch overlay
Entering WARNING+ triggers one-shot 120ms ink jitter on root
ACTIVATE disabled at EXHAUSTED; RESET returns to 25% NOMINAL
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips fill and jitter animations
No network; aria-live announces each strain level
